title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Revising the Installment of an Arrangement in Force
content:
**Customer terms and tool card — revision of a monthly payment arrangement already in force on an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account.**

## Terms

An arrangement already in force on a coverage account is revised when the patient asks for its installment to be re-figured on the balance the account carries now. The revision keeps the arrangement active, keeps its due day, rests on the agreement the patient signed for it, and sets only the monthly installment.

A revised installment is not fixed until the coinsurance charge stemming from the newest oxygen line the primary adjudicated, when that line's date of service is on or after the Medicaid record's effective date, carries the crossover payment that Medicaid owes on it.

| What the revision changes | What it leaves as it is |
|---|---|
| the monthly installment | the arrangement's active status |
| — | the due day of the month |
| — | the agreement the patient signed |

## Recording the new installment: `revise_payment_arrangement_5f5b46f9`

**Capability.** The tool changes the monthly installment of the payment arrangement already in force on a coverage account, as the patient's own act. One call records the new monthly installment on the account's arrangement and changes nothing else: the arrangement keeps its status and its original due day of the month, and the account's arrangement fields carry the new installment.

**Invocation.** The customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `revise_payment_arrangement_5f5b46f9` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `coverage_id` — the reference number of the coverage account whose arrangement is changed, as given to the patient by the agent from the coverage lookup. Identifier.
- `monthly_amount` — the new monthly installment, in USD: a positive figure with 2 decimal places (cents), stored exactly as given, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `coverage_id` (the account changed), `payment_plan_status` (the arrangement's status as recorded on the account, unchanged by this call), `monthly_amount` (the new installment recorded, USD with 2 decimals) and `status`, the string "arrangement_revised". A receipt whose status is "arrangement_revised" means the new installment is in force.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Run on account C-9 with a monthly amount of 36.41, the tool returns the account's arrangement status as it stood (for instance "active"), monthly amount 36.41 and status "arrangement_revised"; the installments keep falling due on the arrangement's original day of the month.
